market_summary: US tech stocks and major indices are navigating mixed sentiment driven by AI spending decisions and regulatory risks. Amazon's plan to offload $8 billion in Nvidia chips signals creative financing of massive capex, while Meta faces a potential $35-40 billion penalty from New Mexico over Cambridge Analytica privacy violations—though Meta called the demand "astronomical." Asian markets are watching Singapore banks for currency exposure and DFI Retail's strategic pivot into Starbucks operations, while geopolitical tensions continue disrupting aviation stocks. Macro and sentiment remain fragile amid ongoing Middle East uncertainties.

items.headline: Amazon seeks to offload $8 billion of Nvidia chips to investors through special-purpose vehicle
items.summary: <cite index="2-1,2-3,2-4">Amazon is seeking to offload about $8 billion of advanced Nvidia chips to external investors via a special purpose vehicle, spinning thousands of Grace Blackwell chips into the vehicle and then leasing the chips back</cite>.

items.headline: New Mexico seeks $35-40 billion penalty against Meta over Cambridge Analytica privacy violations
items.summary: <cite index="11-6">New Mexico asked a judge to order Meta to pay $35-40 billion in penalties after a jury found the company misled consumers about Facebook data privacy</cite>. <cite index="11-5">Meta called the proposed penalty "astronomical" and seeks a cap of $3.45 billion</cite>.

items.headline: Gautam Banerjee, Blackstone Singapore Chairman, appointed to DBS boards
items.summary: <cite index="24-1">DBS Group appointed Gautam Banerjee to the boards of DBS Group Holdings and DBS Bank, effective 1 October 2026</cite>. <cite index="24-4,24-5">Banerjee is chairman and senior managing director of Blackstone Singapore and currently serves on the boards of Singapore Telecommunications and GIC Private Limited</cite>.

items.headline: DFI Retail acquires Starbucks licensed operations across 7 Asian markets for $340 million cash plus business
items.summary: <cite index="33-3,33-6">Maxim's Caterers struck a deal to repurchase its shares from DFI Retail for $340 million while DFI takes over operations of more than 1,100 Starbucks outlets across Asia</cite>. <cite index="37-3">The Starbucks business generated nearly $750 million revenue in 2025 with a 7.0% underlying operating margin</cite>.

items.headline: Singapore Airlines and Scoot extend Middle East flight cancellations to December 2
items.summary: <cite index="40-1,40-3">SIA extended cancellation of flights between Singapore and Dubai until December 2, while Scoot cancelled flights between Singapore and Jeddah to the same date, citing geopolitical situation in the Middle East</cite>.
